column1: # English names for places whose local name is what GeoNames stores.
# GeoNames' ASCII field gives "Munchen", never "Munich" — so without this list
# an English speaker typing the name they actually know finds nothing. The web
# fallback would cover it, but reaching the network for *Munich* would be a
# poor answer. These get folded into the searchable alias field.
# Format:  <name as it appears in the data><TAB><country ISO2><TAB><English name>
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Matching is on the folded name, so accents
# here do not have to be exact.
